narr: Thunderstorms producing heavy rain impacted areas of North Texas during the morning hours on Sept 3rd and produced flooding in Tarrant County.
ev: The City of Fort Worth reported 3 road closures due to flooding. Two were on the south side of town (2100 blk of Cunningham St and 11600 blk of Oak Grove Rd South), and one was just north of downtown (1900 Cold Springs Rd).
lsr: DELAYED REPORT Two road closures were reported by City of Ft Worth on the south side of town. The 2100 block of Cunningham Street and 11600 block of Oak Grove Road South were closed for several hours
